description: The bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 values for different categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", in that order, while the vertical axis is labeled "NDCG@10" with a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 in increments of 0.05. The "- critiquing" category is represented by an orange bar, while the other two categories are represented by blue bars. The "- critiquing" bar has a value of approximately 0.21, the "- scoring" bar has a value of around 0.07, and the "- ranking" bar has a value of about 0.12. The bars are not stacked or grouped, and they are arranged in a specific order corresponding to their labels on the horizontal axis. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the bars beyond their categorical labels, and no bars are visually emphasized.
